body:
## Problem

When a PR review synthesis concludes that no more branch-change automation is needed, orchestration can currently stop instead of consulting the self-approval gate. In full self-governance mode this can leave an otherwise-ready PR stranded: no fix/review loop is warranted, but no self-approval/self-merge path is attempted either.

This is understandable if `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` means "do not run fix-pr/review again", but in self-governance mode it should not necessarily mean "do not consult the approval gate".

## Expected behavior

When all of the following are true:

- target is an open PR;
- latest trusted review synthesis is for the current head;
- final verdict is non-blocking, e.g. `MINOR_ISSUES`;
- recommended next step is `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`;
- synthesis/action items say no required branch-change work remains;
- `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`;

then orchestration should be able to hand off to `agent-self-approve` as the decision gate.

If `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE=true` is also enabled and self-approval returns approved, the existing self-merge handoff can decide whether to merge, enable auto-merge, mark ready, or block.

## Why this matters

`NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` is currently overloaded:

1. no more automated branch mutation/review loops are useful; and
2. no automation at all should continue.

For self-governance, those are different states. A PR can be done with branch changes while still needing an approval decision. In that case, `agent-self-approve` is exactly the deterministic/current-head gate that should make the final approval/block/request-changes decision.

## Possible implementation direction

Options:

1. Update the orchestrator handoff policy so `review -> MINOR_ISSUES + NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` can route to `agent-self-approve` when self-approval is enabled and no required branch-change work remains.
2. Alternatively, change review synthesis to emit `HUMAN_DECISION` instead of `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` for non-blocking done states where a maintainer/self-approval gate should decide.
3. Make the provenance accepted by `agent-self-approve` explicit for this case, so it does not only trust `SHIP` or `HUMAN_DECISION` when the current-head synthesis says no required branch-change work remains.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add/update tests for a PR orchestration handoff where latest review synthesis is current-head `MINOR_ISSUES`, recommends `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`, and says no required branch-change work remains.
- With `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`, that scenario dispatches or permits `agent-self-approve` rather than stopping.
- With self-approval disabled, the orchestrator still stops cleanly and explains why.
- Blocking findings or required branch-change action items must still prevent self-approval and route to fix/review/stop as appropriate.
- Documentation clarifies that `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` from review means no more branch mutation/review loops, not necessarily no approval gate in self-governance mode.

## Related context

This follows the same self-governance direction as PR #299, which added same-actor self-approval/status-comment handling when both self-approval and self-merge are enabled.

comments.body:
@sepo-agent /answer 

can you analyze this? also can you check all conditions similar to this?

I analyzed #318 against the current `main` code and the related merged PR #299. The issue is valid, and there are two closely related gaps.

Current behavior:

- `SHIP` review + `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true` already routes to `agent-self-approve`.
  Code: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/cf1485fbeb30847c734401e721227ee3868b1774/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L491-L501
- `HUMAN_DECISION` + self-approval enabled already routes to `agent-self-approve`, including non-`SHIP` verdicts.
  Code: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/cf1485fbeb30847c734401e721227ee3868b1774/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L478-L489
- Self-approval provenance currently trusts only current-head `SHIP`, or current-head `HUMAN_DECISION` when that gate is explicitly allowed.
  Code: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/cf1485fbeb30847c734401e721227ee3868b1774/.agent/src/self-approval.ts#L203-L219

The missing case is:

- `MINOR_ISSUES`
- `Recommended Next Step: NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`
- no required branch-change action items
- self-approval enabled

That currently has no explicit self-approval path. In agent-planner mode, the orchestrator prompt even tells the planner to stop on `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/cf1485fbeb30847c734401e721227ee3868b1774/.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md#L88-L91

There is also a similar heuristic-mode mismatch: `MINOR_ISSUES`, `NEEDS_REWORK`, and `CHANGES_REQUESTED` all currently fall through to `fix-pr` unless the recommendation is `HUMAN_DECISION`, so `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` is not respected there either.
Code: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/cf1485fbeb30847c734401e721227ee3868b1774/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L503-L513

I would treat the similar conditions this way:

| Verdict | Recommended next step | Required branch-change work? | Self-approval enabled? | Correct handoff |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| `SHIP` | any / absent / `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` | no | yes | `agent-self-approve` |
| `SHIP` | any / absent / `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` | no | no | stop cleanly |
| `MINOR_ISSUES` | `HUMAN_DECISION` | optional/judgment only | yes | `agent-self-approve` |
| `MINOR_ISSUES` | `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` | no | yes | `agent-self-approve` |
| `MINOR_ISSUES` | `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` | no | no | stop cleanly |
| `MINOR_ISSUES` | `FIX_PR` or required action items | yes | any | `fix-pr` |
| `NEEDS_REWORK` / `CHANGES_REQUESTED` | `FIX_PR` or required action items | yes | any | `fix-pr` |
| `NEEDS_REWORK` / `CHANGES_REQUESTED` | `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` | no | any | stop/block, not approve |
| any blocking verdict | any | yes or unclear | any | do not self-approve |

Implementation plan:

1. Add a small structured helper in `.agent/src/handoff.ts` to distinguish “required branch-change action items exist” from sentinel/no-op items like `No required branch-change work remains`.
2. Update review-originated handoff policy so `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` is treated as “no more branch mutation/review loop,” not “no approval gate.”
3. Permit `MINOR_ISSUES + NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION + no required branch-change work` to route to `agent-self-approve` when `AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_APPROVE=true`.
4. Keep `NEEDS_REWORK` and `CHANGES_REQUESTED` out of this approval shortcut unless the recommendation is the already-supported `HUMAN_DECISION` gate.
5. Extend `evaluateSelfApprovalProvenance()` so this exact `MINOR_ISSUES + NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION + no required branch work` provenance can be trusted for the current head.
6. Update `.github/prompts/agent-orchestrator.md` and `.agent/docs/technical-details/agent-orchestrator.md` so `NO_AUTOMATED_ACTION` is documented as no more branch-change automation, not necessarily no self-governance approval gate.
7. Add tests in `handoff.test.ts`, `orchestrate-handoff-cli.test.ts`, `prepare-self-approve-cli.test.ts`, and `self-approval.test.ts` for the allowed path and the blocked variants.

No clarification blockers from my side. The main design choice is whether to name this as a new internal predicate like `reviewHasNoRequiredBranchWork()` or encode it directly in the handoff/provenance checks; I’d prefer the helper so the condition stays consistent across dispatch, handoff, and self-approval provenance.

title: Route no-more-branch-work review outcomes to self-approval
